parameters.name: AclEntryComment
parameters.description: The description of the entries in the access control policy group.

parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the access control policy group to query.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page number for the paged query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in the paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the access control policy group.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query region IDs.
